name: 云帐房AI开票
description: Use Yunzhangfang AI invoicing services to extract billing information, match tax classification codes, and open the e-tax bureau invoicing flow.
description_zh: 通过自然语言使用云帐房 AI 开票能力，完成开票信息识别、商品税收分类匹配，并前往电子税局开票。
description_en: Use Yunzhangfang AI invoicing services to extract billing information, match tax classification codes, and open the e-tax bureau invoicing flow.
examples_zh: 购买方是云帐房，开票项目是软件服务费，含税金额 12000 元，帮我生成一张发票
公司名称云帐房，开票项目咨询服务费，金额 6800 元，帮我识别开票信息，并告诉我还缺哪些字段
把这张发票的购买方名称改成云帐房，开票项目改成技术服务费，金额保持 3600 元不变
购买方、开票项目、金额和接收邮箱都确认无误了，帮我前往电子税局开票
examples_en: The buyer is Yunzhangfang, invoice item software service fee, and tax-included amount 12000 CNY. Create an invoice for me
Company name Yunzhangfang, invoice item consulting service fee, and amount 6800 CNY. Extract the billing information and tell me which fields are missing
Update this invoice buyer name to Yunzhangfang, change the invoice item to technical service fee, and keep the amount as 3600 CNY
The buyer, invoice item, amount, and recipient email have all been confirmed. Open the e-tax bureau invoicing flow
